fullPassage: Our environment is in trouble. With the planet becoming warmer, sea levels are rising and natural disasters such as forest fires and floods are increasing. More and more waste is also being produced. Plastic, in particular, is causing problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature. Will we be able to protect the environment from mountains of plastic? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems difficult. Nature, however, may have provided us with solutions to these problems. Here are three areas where changes are already happening. About fifty percent of plastic is produced for single-use products. That means the items are used just once and then discarded. Do you ever stop to think about where these plastic items go after you throw them away? Recycling can help reduce the amount of plastic in our landfills. However, less than ten percent of the world's plastic waste has been recycled so far. Often, plastic waste is moved to places where it is just dumped or burned. Furthermore, between 8 and 14 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean every year. This puts many marine species in danger. With this in mind, scientists are turning to mealworms. Mealworms are the larvae of a certain species of beetle. Special bacteria live inside them. These bacteria can break down plastic. This means that mealworms can actually feed on plastic. Scientists are now looking for ways to cultivate the bacteria outside of mealworms. They also want to speed up the process by which the bacteria break down plastic. This may help us keep our landfills plastic-free. Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe. Although polluted soil can be dug up and transported to a landfill, this process is expensive. Moreover, it only moves the problem to another area and does not really solve it. Fortunately, there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to restore polluted soil — planting willow trees. These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems. As a result, they naturally extract a wide range of harmful materials from the soil. They can also grow quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have found that some species of willow trees are able to absorb harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further explored to find out which trees are the most effective. In time, we may be able to clean up our land with willow trees. Statistics show that about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee each day. The coffee-making process, however, generates used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills. There, they can create a harmful greenhouse gas. Unfortunately, there's no way to stop everyone in the world from drinking coffee. However, we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel. Biofuel is a natural fuel that is made from plant or animal sources. Researchers have found that they can grow algae on old coffee grounds without adding any other nutrients. If these algae are exposed to twenty hours of light and four hours of darkness each day, they eventually produce high-quality biofuel. The biofuel is renewable and sustainable, and it creates only a small amount of emissions. These are just a few solutions we can find in nature. There could be many more possible solutions to the problems we currently face. It seems that Mother Nature has given us one more chance. In return, we need to look for more ways to keep the environment healthy and clean. If we do, the future of our planet may be bright after all.

③ seems: 'Achieving these goals seems difficult'에서 동명사구 주어(Achieving these goals)는 단수 취급이라 단수 동사 seems가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ which → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'three areas ___ changes are already happening'에서 뒤 절(changes are already happening)이 주어·동사를 갖춘 완전한 절이에요. 선행사 areas는 장소이므로 관계부사 where로 써야 해요. which는 뒤에 불완전한 절이 와야 하므로 틀려요. ❌ which는 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: 선행사(areas, 장소) + 완전한 절 → 관계부사 where

det.korean: 커피 찌꺼기를 이용한 조류 바이오 연료.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 본문 'Researchers have found that they can grow algae on old coffee grounds without adding any other nutrients'와 일치 ←정답

❌ ② 본문 'used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills'에서 커피 찌꺼기는 보통 '매립지'로 보내진다고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ③ 본문 'about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee'에서 약 30~40%라고 했으므로 70%는 불일치

❌ ④ 본문 'it creates only a small amount of emissions'에서 '적은 양'의 배출물만 나온다고 했으므로 불일치
det.tip: grow algae ~ without adding any other nutrients(영양분 없이 조류 배양)가 일치합니다.

ch: 연구자들은 추가 영양분 없이 오래된 커피 찌꺼기에서 조류를 길러낼 수 있음을 알아냈다.
커피 찌꺼기는 보통 재활용 공장으로 보내져 그곳에서 처리된다.
세계 인구의 약 70%가 매일 커피를 마신다.
바이오 연료는 많은 양의 배출물을 발생시킨다.

questions.passage: Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe. Although polluted soil can be ①<u>dug</u> up and transported to a landfill, this process is expensive. Moreover, it only moves the problem to another area and does not really solve it. Fortunately, there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to restore polluted soil — planting willow trees. These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems. As a result, they naturally extract a wide range of harmful materials from the soil. They can also ②<u>grew</u> quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have ③<u>found</u> that some species of willow trees are able to absorb harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further explored to find out which trees are the most effective. In time, we may be able to ④<u>clean</u> up our land with willow trees.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② grew → grow: 조동사 can 뒤이므로 동사원형 grow
det.analysis:
① dug: 'Although polluted soil can be dug up and transported to a landfill'에서 'can be + 과거분사'의 수동태라 dug(dig의 과거분사)가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② grew → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'They can also ___ quickly'에서 조동사 can 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 해요. 따라서 grow로 써야 해요. grew(과거형)는 조동사 뒤에 올 수 없어 틀려요. ❌ grew는 틀림 ←정답

③ found: 'Scientists have found that some species of willow trees ~'에서 'have + 과거분사'의 현재완료라 found(find의 과거분사)가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ clean: 'we may be able to clean up our land'에서 'be able to + 동사원형'이라 clean이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 조동사 can + 동사원형: can grow

questions.passage: Mining and other industries are causing soil pollution across the globe. Although polluted soil can be dug up and transported to a landfill, this process is expensive. Moreover, it only moves the problem to another area and does not really solve it. Fortunately, there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to restore polluted soil — planting willow trees. These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems. As a result, they naturally extract a wide range of harmful materials from the soil. They can also grow quickly, even in soil with a high acidity level or a lot of heavy metals in it. Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have found that some species of willow trees are able to absorb harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further explored to find out which trees are the most effective.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 오염된 토양을 복구하는 친환경적이고 비용 대비 효과적인 방법으로 무엇을 심는 것을 제시하는지, 그 나무를 가리키는 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 오염된 토양을 복구하는 방법.
det.analysis: 본문 'there is an eco-friendly and cost-effective way to restore polluted soil — planting willow trees.'에서 오염된 토양을 복구하는 친환경적이고 비용 대비 효과적인 방법으로 '버드나무(willow trees)'를 심는 것을 제시했다.
det.tip: planting willow trees에서 willow trees를 찾습니다.

questions.passage: Statistics show that about thirty to forty percent of people in the world drink coffee each day. The coffee-making process, however, generates used coffee grounds, which are normally sent to landfills. There, they can create a harmful greenhouse gas. Unfortunately, there's no way to stop everyone in the world from drinking coffee. However, we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel. Biofuel is a natural fuel that is made from plant or animal sources. Researchers have found that they can grow algae on old coffee grounds without adding any other nutrients. If these algae are exposed to twenty hours of light and four hours of darkness each day, they eventually produce high-quality biofuel.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 사용된 커피 찌꺼기를 바이오 연료로 바꿈으로써 우리가 줄일 수 있는 것이 무엇인지, 그 대상을 나타내는 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (3단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 커피 찌꺼기를 바이오 연료로 바꿔 줄이는 것.
det.analysis: 본문 'we can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning used coffee grounds into biofuel.'에서 사용된 커피 찌꺼기를 바이오 연료로 바꿈으로써 '온실가스 배출(greenhouse gas emissions)'을 줄일 수 있다고 했다.
det.tip: reduce greenhouse gas emissions by turning ~에서 greenhouse gas emissions를 찾습니다.

questions.passage: These bacteria can break down plastic. This __________ (mean) that mealworms can actually feed on plastic. Scientists are now looking for ways to cultivate the bacteria outside of mealworms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: means (3인칭 단수 현재).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'This ___ that ~'에서 빈칸은 문장의 동사 자리다. 주어 This는 3인칭 단수이고 현재의 일반적 사실을 말하므로 동사에 -s를 붙여 means로 바꿔야 한다. 'This means that ~(이것은 ~을 의미한다)'로 해석된다.
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어 This + 현재형 → means

questions.passage: Our environment is in trouble. With the planet becoming warmer, sea levels are rising and natural disasters such as forest fires and floods are increasing. More and more waste is also being produced. Plastic, in particular, is causing problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature. Will we be able to protect the environment from mountains of plastic? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems difficult.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 중심 소재.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 글은 플라스틱 쓰레기 처리(밀웜), 오염된 토양 정화(버드나무), 조류 바이오 연료 생산 등 자연에서 찾은 환경 문제 해결 방안 세 가지를 다룸 ← 정답

❌ ① 커피는 바이오 연료 사례의 일부일 뿐 주제가 아님

❌ ② 재활용의 경제적 이익은 본문의 초점이 아님

❌ ④ 밀웜은 플라스틱 분해 사례일 뿐 반려동물 사육과 무관
det.tip: 'Here are three areas where changes are already happening'으로 제시된 세 가지 해결책이 주제입니다.

ch: 커피가 전 세계에서 소비되는 다양한 방식
플라스틱 재활용 산업이 창출하는 경제적 이익
자연에서 찾은, 환경 문제를 해결할 세 가지 방안

questions.passage: Our environment is in trouble. With the planet becoming warmer, sea levels are rising and natural disasters such as forest fires and floods are increasing. More and more waste is also being produced. Plastic, in particular, is causing problems with soil and water pollution. It is clear that humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature. Will we be able to protect the environment from mountains of plastic? Can we stop climate change from reaching dangerous levels? Achieving these goals seems difficult.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심 메시지.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문 'humans are a major contributor to the destruction of nature'에서 인간이 주요 원인이라 했으므로 반대

✅ ② 본문 'Nature ~ may have provided us with solutions ~ we need to look for more ways to keep the environment healthy and clean'과 통하는 핵심 메시지 ← 정답

❌ ③ 본문 'less than ten percent ~ has been recycled'에서 10% 미만만 재활용된다 했으므로 반대

❌ ④ 본문은 바이오 연료를 재생·지속 가능한 해결책으로 긍정 평가하므로 반대
det.tip: 자연이 준 해결책을 살리고 환경을 지킬 방법을 더 찾자는 것이 요지입니다.

ch: 인간은 환경 파괴에 아무런 책임이 없다.
자연은 환경 문제의 해결책을 제공하므로, 우리는 환경을 건강하게 지킬 방법을 더 찾아야 한다.
플라스틱은 전량 재활용되므로 더 이상 환경 문제가 아니다.
바이오 연료는 비용이 너무 많이 들어 실용적이지 않다.

Research on the effectiveness of using willow trees for this purpose is in development. Scientists have found that some species of willow trees are able to absorb harmful materials better than others. Therefore, this promising area should be further explored to find out which trees are the most effective. In time, we may be able to clean up our land with willow trees.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"이 놀라운 나무들은 광범위하고 잘 발달된 뿌리 체계를 가지고 있다." (9단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) amazing, and, extensive, have, root, systems, These, trees, well-developed 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 9단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems
det.analysis:
주어는 '이 놀라운 나무들'이에요: These + amazing + trees.

동사는 '가지고 있다'로 주어가 복수이므로 have를 써요: have.

무엇을 가지고 있는가 하면 '광범위하고 잘 발달된 뿌리 체계'예요. 두 형용사(extensive, well-developed)를 and로 이어 명사구(root systems)를 꾸며요: extensive + and + well-developed + root + systems.

순서대로 이으면 These / amazing / trees / have / extensive / and / well-developed / root / systems.
det.tip: 복수 주어 + have + 형용사 and 형용사 + 명사: 두 형용사를 and로 병렬

questions.wa: These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems
accept: These amazing trees have extensive and well-developed root systems
